archimate:Outcome.name: National / Unified Health Accounts Published on Schedule
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
National/Unified Health Accounts published on schedule" is a governance performance metric that tracks whether a government or health ministry releases its comprehensive annual report on countrywide healthcare spending within its pre-established deadline.
The purpose of this metric is to ensure that policymakers, donors, and the public have timely, reliable data on where health financing comes from and how it is spent, which is essential for evidence-based budgeting and holding the health system accountable.
Example: A Ministry of Health meets this indicator if it publishes its 2025 National Health Accounts report by its target date of June 1, 2026, allowing legislators to use the actual spending data to finalize the upcoming fiscal year's budget.
